issues_detected.description: Clinical data from about 50,000 patient admissions, but no ethics review, consent or waiver, human_subject_research or participant_privacy declaration; deidentification is stated only for imaging, in process.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document IRB/ethics oversight, consent or waiver basis, HIPAA status and the deidentification method for all modalities.

issues_detected.description: No DOI, citation, version or publisher; id is the project website URL rather than a dataset identifier.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add a persistent dataset identifier, version, publisher and a formal dataset citation.

issues_detected.description: No distribution_formats, file enumeration or download/enclave access URL; file types are only implied by data standards, and the access path is described only for training-program participants.
issues_detected.recommendation: Enumerate the delivered file formats and name the enclave platform and general researcher access route.

issues_detected.description: A licensing agreement is required but its terms are unstated; no IP restrictions, confidentiality level, intended/prohibited uses or impact analysis.
issues_detected.recommendation: State the data use agreement terms, confidentiality classification and use restrictions.

issues_detected.description: No known biases, demographics or inclusion/exclusion criteria for a multi-site retrospective critical-care cohort.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document demographic distributions, per-site/per-unit counts, inclusion criteria and known biases.

issues_detected.description: Processing and collection are described in text only, without tool versions, collection timeframes, raw source fields, missing-data documentation or version history.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add collection date ranges, tool versions, raw sources and a change log.

issues_detected.description: No variables, resources or parent_datasets; seven keywords omit imaging, waveform and OMOP terms.
issues_detected.recommendation: Describe key variables/tables and add modality keywords.

issues_detected.description: notes gives the contact address with domain 'mgh.havard.edu', an apparent misspelling of harvard; the record flags it as written on the site.
issues_detected.recommendation: Verify the contact address before relying on it.

issues_detected.description: Admission counts differ by source (50,000 on the website vs over 45K as of August 2025), and '23 Tb' is an ambiguous unit; both are disclosed in source_caveats.
issues_detected.recommendation: Give a dated count for a named release and a byte unit.

issues_detected.description: creators are the project leadership team; the record discloses that dataset authorship roles are not stated.
issues_detected.recommendation: Record credit roles or authorship when documented.

Major gaps in ethics/privacy, versioning, persistent identification, bias and distribution-format documentation.
